dependencies.name: @tanstack/react-query
dependencies.capability: Server-state caching, cancellation, pagination, invalidation, and retry control

Visibility changes evict restricted cached data

dependencies.name: @tanstack/react-table

Cell editing and virtualization require composition

dependencies.name: @tanstack/react-virtual

security_privacy: No special risk

dependencies.name: react-resizable-panels

dependencies.name: Radix UI primitives, selectively adopted

dependencies.name: @playwright/test
dependencies.capability: Cross-browser E2E, trusted input, mobile emulation, screenshots, traces, multi-user flows
dependencies.compatibility: Node 22 compatible; complements Vitest/jsdom rather than replacing it
dependencies.accessibility_posture: Enables real-browser keyboard, zoom, forced-colors, reduced-motion, and responsive testing; screen-reader testing still needs separate human/AT work

governance_risks: Fixture mutations must be isolated and deterministic
security_privacy: Traces/screenshots can contain restricted fixture data; retention policy required
dependencies.replacement_strategy: Tests use stable role/label locators and project fixtures
poc_success_criteria: Run critical authoring/review flows in three engines
Test 320px, 200% zoom, forced colors, keyboard-only, unknown outcome, and cross-origin transport
